t: XII. MISREPRESENTATIONS CORRECTED AND TRUTH VINDICATED, IN REPLY TO THE REV. SOLOMON WILLIAMS. › THE TRUE STATE OF THE QUESTION CONCERNING THE QUALIFICATIONS NECESSARY...

items.e: Prov. xii. 17.He that speaketh truth, showeth forth righteousness.

Chap. xxii. 20, 21. Have I not written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge; that I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth, that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
